passive.name: Pit Grit
passive.description: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.description: Sett itches for a fight, gaining % Move Speed towards enemy champions for seconds. Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional plus max Health physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MaxHealthDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.description: Passive: Sett stores % of damage taken as Grit, up to . Grit decays quickly seconds after the damage was taken. Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a % Grit consumed Shield decaying over seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing plus Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.description: Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing physical damage and Slowing them by % for seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are Stunned for second.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.description: Sett grabs an enemy champion and Suppresses them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing plus % of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by % for second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.
